# dtcloud_regions (Data Source)

Lists the regions available to the account.

The region a resource is created in comes from the provider's `region_id`, not from here; this is
how to discover the valid values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_regions" "all" {}

output "region_ids" {
  value = data.dtcloud_regions.all.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ids` (List of Number) Just the ids.
- `regions` (List of Object) The regions visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available_services` (List of String)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)

## Behaviour worth knowing

* **`available_services` lists only what is available**, sorted, so `contains()` is the natural check.
  A region the platform reports no availability information for has an empty list.
* **Changing the active region is not exposed.** The API endpoint for it switches the caller's
  session rather than any infrastructure; the provider takes its region through `region_id` instead.
